basis: Reviewed source objectives, targets and output purpose; runtime acceptance is separate.

command:Show Failed Sign-Ins.code:
$Since = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddHours(-48).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
Get-MgAuditLogSignIn -Filter "userPrincipalName eq 'user@domain.com' and createdDateTime ge $Since" -All |
  Where-Object { $_.Status.ErrorCode -ne 0 } |
  Select-Object CreatedDateTime,AppDisplayName,IPAddress,ClientAppUsed,
    @{N="ErrorCode";E={$_.Status.ErrorCode}},
    @{N="FailureReason";E={$_.Status.FailureReason}}

command:Show Entra Sign-ins - Last 48 Ho.code:
$Since = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddHours(-48).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
Get-MgAuditLogSignIn -Filter "userPrincipalName eq 'user@domain.com' and createdDateTime ge $Since" -All |
  Select-Object CreatedDateTime,AppDisplayName,IPAddress,ClientAppUsed,ConditionalAccessStatus,
    @{N="Status";E={if($_.Status.ErrorCode -eq 0){"Success"}else{"Failed: $($_.Status.ErrorCode)"}}}

command:Show Legacy / Other-client Sign-.code:
$Since = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddDays(-7).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
Get-MgAuditLogSignIn -Filter "userPrincipalName eq 'user@domain.com' and createdDateTime ge $Since" -All |
  Where-Object { $_.ClientAppUsed -eq "Other clients" } |
  Select-Object CreatedDateTime,AppDisplayName,IPAddress,ClientAppUsed,
    @{N="Status";E={if($_.Status.ErrorCode -eq 0){"Success"}else{"Failed"}}}

command:Show Successful Sign-Ins.code:
$Since = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddHours(-48).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
Get-MgAuditLogSignIn -Filter "userPrincipalName eq 'user@domain.com' and createdDateTime ge $Since" -All |
  Where-Object { $_.Status.ErrorCode -eq 0 } |
  Select-Object CreatedDateTime,AppDisplayName,IPAddress,ClientAppUsed,ConditionalAccessStatus

command:Show Listening Tcp Ports.code:
Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen |
  Sort-Object LocalPort |
  Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess

command:Find Files Modified In Last 24 H.code:
$Path = "C:\Temp"
Get-ChildItem $Path -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object LastWriteTime -ge (Get-Date).AddHours(-24) |
  Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

command:Show Computer Model And Serial N.code:
$System = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem
$Bios = Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS
[pscustomobject]@{
  Manufacturer = $System.Manufacturer
  Model = $System.Model
  SerialNumber = $Bios.SerialNumber
}

command:Show Installed Microsoft Graph M.code: Get-Module Microsoft.Graph.Authentication -ListAvailable | Sort-Object Version -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 Name,Version,Path

command:Show Installed ExchangeOnlineMan.code: Get-Module ExchangeOnlineManagement -ListAvailable | Sort-Object Version -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 Name,Version,Path
